daml.name: DAML
daml.description: Stephan Günnemann's group: certified robustness of graph neural networks. Abbreviations: DAML stands for Data Analytics and Machine Learning, the name of Stephan Günnemann's group at the Technical University of Munich (TUM).

bai-xue.name: Bai Xue group
bai-xue.description: Bai Xue's group at the Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences (ISCAS): barrier certificates for neural network controllers and statistically guaranteed precondition synthesis.

singh-uiuc.name: Singh group
singh-uiuc.description: Gagandeep Singh's group at UIUC: relational and incremental verification. Abbreviations: UIUC: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

cora.name: CORA
cora.description: Set-based reachability for neural networks and cyber-physical systems. Abbreviations: CORA is the COntinuous Reachability Analyzer; TUM: Technical University of Munich.

venus.name: Venus
venus.description: Alessio Lomuscio's group: MILP-based and symbolic-interval verification.

abcrown.name: α,β-CROWN
abcrown.description: GPU bound propagation and branch and bound; winner of VNN-COMP 2021 to 2025.

eran.name: ERAN
eran.description: Abstract interpretation, certified training and branch and bound at ETH Zurich. Abbreviations: ERAN is the ETH Robustness Analyzer for Neural Networks; SRI Lab is the Secure, Reliable, and Intelligent Systems Lab at ETH Zurich.

dlv.name: DLV / DeepGame
dlv.description: Marta Kwiatkowska and Xiaowei Huang. Abbreviations: DLV stands for deep learning verification; DeepGame is the group's game-based robustness tool.

iscas-zhang.name: DeepPAC
iscas-zhang.description: Lijun Zhang's group at the Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences (ISCAS): PAC-model robustness analysis (DeepPAC, TrajPAC), verification-friendly training and certification of detection pipelines. Abbreviations: DeepPAC: robustness analysis based on PAC (probably approximately correct) model learning.

ecnu.name: Min Zhang group
ecnu.description: Min Zhang's group at East China Normal University. Abbreviations: ECNU: East China Normal University.

nnv.name: NNV
nnv.description: Star-set reachability of neural networks and neural control systems. Abbreviations: NNV is the Neural Network Verification tool; VeriVITAL is the Verification and Validation for Intelligent and Trustworthy Autonomy Laboratory (Vanderbilt University).

oval.name: OVAL
oval.description: Branch and bound and dual bounds at Oxford. Abbreviations: OVAL: the Optimization for Vision and Learning group (M. Pawan Kumar) at the University of Oxford.

gloro.name: GloRo
gloro.description: Matt Fredrikson's group: globally-robust networks. Abbreviations: GloRo stands for globally-robust (networks); CMU: Carnegie Mellon University.

formal-xai.name: Formal XAI
formal-xai.description: Formal explanations of machine-learning classifiers: abductive and contrastive explanations, their duality with adversarial examples, and their complexity. Abbreviations: XAI: explainable artificial intelligence.

peregrinn.name: PeregriNN
peregrinn.description: Yasser Shoukry's group at UC Irvine. Abbreviations: UCI: University of California, Irvine.

vnncomp.name: VNN-COMP
vnncomp.description: Organisers of the International Verification of Neural Networks Competition at RWTH Aachen University.

linyi-li.name: Linyi Li group
linyi-li.description: Certified robustness and verification at Simon Fraser University. Abbreviations: SFU: Simon Fraser University.

misailovic.name: Misailovic group
misailovic.description: Abbreviations: UIUC: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

secure-learning.name: Secure Learning Lab
secure-learning.description: Certified robustness of ML and RL (Bo Li).

daniel-mit.name: Daniel group
daniel-mit.description: Luca Daniel's group at MIT: the origins of CROWN. Abbreviations: MIT: Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

deepmind.name: DeepMind verification
deepmind.description: Verification and certified training at Google DeepMind.

reliable-ai.name: Reliable AI Lab
reliable-ai.description: Soheil Feizi's lab: certified robustness and Lipschitz certification. Abbreviations: UMD: University of Maryland.

socrates.name: Socrates
socrates.description: Jun Sun's group at Singapore Management University. Abbreviations: Socrates is the group's platform for neural network analysis; SMU: Singapore Management University.

ista.name: Henzinger group
ista.description: Quantized-network verification and verified RL. Abbreviations: ISTA: Institute of Science and Technology Austria.

hein.name: Hein group
hein.description: Matthias Hein's group: provable robustness and OOD guarantees.

prdnn.name: PRDNN
prdnn.description: Aditya Thakur's group: provable repair. Abbreviations: PRDNN stands for provable repair of deep neural networks.

pappas.name: Pappas group
pappas.description: George Pappas's group at the University of Pennsylvania.

chao-wang.name: Chao Wang group
chao-wang.description: Chao Wang's group at USC: verification of neural networks and fairness. Abbreviations: USC: University of Southern California.

fu-song.name: QVIP / QEBVerif
fu-song.description: Quantized neural network verification. Abbreviations: QVIP: verification of quantized networks by integer linear programming; QEBVerif: quantization error bound verification.

weng-ucsd.name: Weng group
weng-ucsd.description: Tsui-Wei Weng's Trustworthy ML lab. Abbreviations: UCSD: University of California San Diego.

goldstein.name: Goldstein group
goldstein.description: Tom Goldstein's group at UMD: certified defenses. Abbreviations: UMD: University of Maryland.

mipverify.name: MIPVerify
mipverify.description: Russ Tedrake's group at MIT. Abbreviations: MIPVerify: verification by mixed-integer programming (MIP).

vere.name: VeRe / ProRepair
vere.description: Jingyi Wang (Zhejiang University) with Zhen Wang and Jianan Ma (Hangzhou Dianzi University) and Qi Xuan (Zhejiang University of Technology): provable repair of neural networks (VeRe, ProRepair, patch synthesis).

charon.name: Charon
charon.description: Isil Dillig and Swarat Chaudhuri at UT Austin.

gao-ucsd.name: Gao group
gao-ucsd.description: Sicun Gao's group: neural Lyapunov control. Abbreviations: UCSD: University of California San Diego.

pku.name: PKU
pku.description: Liwei Wang's group at Peking University: certified training. Abbreviations: PKU: Peking University.

stanford-ml.name: Liang group
stanford-ml.description: Percy Liang's group: SDP relaxations and certified defenses.

wicker.name: Matthew Wicker group
wicker.description: Certification of learned models: robust explanations and certified bounds on differentially private predictions.

lions.name: LIONS
lions.description: Volkan Cevher's group at EPFL. Abbreviations: LIONS: the Laboratory for Information and Inference Systems at EPFL (École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne).

my-thai.name: My T. Thai lab
my-thai.description: My T. Thai's lab at the University of Florida, with NhatHai Phan (NJIT): differential privacy with certified robustness. UF: University of Florida.

pasareanu.name: Pasareanu group
pasareanu.description: Abbreviations: CMU: Carnegie Mellon University; NASA: NASA Ames Research Center.

youcheng-sun.name: Youcheng Sun group
youcheng-sun.description: Youcheng Sun (Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence, MBZUAI): testing and verification of neural networks, with collaborators at ISCAS, Liverpool and NASA.

ling-liang.name: Ling Liang group
ling-liang.description: Certified defences and certified training for spiking neural networks.

yaniv-romano.name: Romano group
yaniv-romano.description: Conformal prediction with certified robustness to adversarial perturbations.
